description: An abstract Angular component class for contact-based entities, managing form building, updating, and validation, including country-specific zip code validation.

classes.name: ContactBasedComponent
classes.description: An abstract Angular component class for contact-based entities, providing form management and validation logic.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs a form group with controls for contact entity fields, including country, city, state, zip, address, phone, and email.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Updates the form with new entity data and revalidates zip code based on country.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up a subscription to country field changes to dynamically update zip code validators.

methods.name: zipValidators
methods.description: Returns validators for zip code based on the selected country's postcode pattern.

methods.name: buildEntityForm
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for building the entity-specific form.

methods.name: updateEntityForm
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for updating the entity-specific form.
